title: Trezor says third-party security breach led to phishing emails from legitimate domain
summary: This follows last month's security breach at shipping provider ShipMonk, which exposed the personal information of Trezor customers.
content: Hardware wallet provider Trezor reported a third-party security breach that resulted in phishing emails being sent to customers from a legitimate domain. The incident follows a data breach last month at shipping provider ShipMonk, which exposed personal information belonging to Trezor customers. Security incidents of this nature often increase the risk of targeted phishing attacks against cryptocurrency users.

summary:

The post Iran continues executions despite public pardons, consolidating regime power appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Iran has continued carrying out executions despite announcements of public pardons. title: Bitcoin Open Interest climbs before CPI – Is $82K next for BTC?
summary: Despite evidence of long-term holders taking profits and selling into bullish strength, the BTC price continued to hold up well above the $76k demand zone.
content: Bitcoin open interest has risen ahead of upcoming Consumer Price Index data releases, raising questions about whether the cryptocurrency might target the $82,000 level next. Even as some long-term holders secure profits by selling into the current bullish strength, the Bitcoin price has demonstrated resilience, remaining stable well above the key $76,000 demand zone.
